summary: Checked all 9 repos in scope; 5 had no open PRs and green default-branch CI so nothing to do. Merged 11 green dependency PRs (5 in kinz-secure-commerce-hub, 6 in Next.js-SaaS). Left stuck: 5 kinz-secure-commerce-hub dependabot PRs and 2 Next.js-SaaS dependabot PRs pending a dependabot rebase (comment posted, first ask); 2 Next.js-SaaS PRs (recharts, @ai-sdk/react) flagged open as genuine breaking changes for the owner; 2 btc-llm-sentiment PRs stuck on a pre-existing missing-'requests'-in-CI gap whose fix (PR #58) touches .github/workflows/ci.yml and so cannot be auto-merged under the protected-paths rule; kinz-accounting-analysis PR #22 (green CI) left untouched because it changes how margin_pct is derived, per the repo's standing owner-review rule.
